Cohort-level MFI per population and marker, overall and per study group

Source: R/figures-mfi.R
summarise_mfi.Rd

One row per panel, population (or cluster), marker and group, where the group is "All samples" plus each study group when there are two or more. Controls and staining-QC failures are dropped first, as for every group comparison.

Usage

summarise_mfi(
  mfi,
  transforms = NULL,
  group_of = NULL,
  label_col = "population",
  value_col = "median_asinh",
  pos_col = "pct_positive",
  count_col = "n_cells",
  scatter = character(0)
)

Arguments

mfi

Per-sample table: sample_id, the label column, marker, the analysis-scale median, and optionally panel, pct_positive, n_cells.

transforms

Either one transform or a list of them named by panel.

group_of

Optional named vector, sample_id -> group.

label_col

Name of the population or cluster column.

value_col

Name of the analysis-scale median column.

pos_col

Name of the percent-positive column, if any.

count_col

Name of the cell-count column, if any.

scatter

Markers on a log10 scatter scale. See mfi_back_transform().

Value

data.frame, or NULL when there is nothing to summarise.
